summary: Pinned curl at 8.12.1-4.el10 using the native EL10 DNF versionlock plugin. A newer 8.12.1-6.el10 candidate remains available, but update attempts before and after reboot left curl unchanged. CentOS Stream 10 and kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 were retained.
actions_performed: Installed python3-dnf-plugin-versionlock from the CentOS Stream 10 BaseOS repository.
Verified DNF refused to upgrade curl despite a newer repository candidate.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Reverified the lock, curl binary, OS release, kernel, and update behavior after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Keep installed curl at its current version during system updates
evidence.summary: The exact versionlock is persisted. DNF sees curl 8.12.1-6.el10 when the plugin is disabled, but reports “Nothing to do” with the lock active; curl remains 8.12.1-4.el10 before and after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: CentOS Stream 10 and kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 remained installed and running throughout the task and reboot.

Healthy baseline used boot ID a70d7f83-6867-4c91-851d-7a1228689bb3; reboot was acknowledged; node1 returned running with boot ID d9a7cf8f-eee8-4f54-97e0-a5781c6d7207; curl, its lock, OS release, and kernel all recovered and were directly revalidated.
